title: Book One · Chapter 91: Only One Blue Pot
story:
The mornings grow cooler. Ronan wears his old jacket to school.

Mum unfolded the ends of the sleeves. Now they are longer. The old fold left a pale line on each sleeve. He pulls the cuffs over his wrists. He tries not to look at the pale line.

In class, Miss Wu shows them the paint for the boat pages. There is one blue pot and one red pot. A larger pot holds white paint.

“Not enough for everyone's sea,” Leo says.

“Then everyone's sea cannot cover the whole sheet,” Miss Wu answers.

They are making a shared book of the project. The wall pages will stay in class. The book will have one smaller page from each group. There is a cover to make too.

Ronan wanted a blue sea on his page. Many other children want one too.

Mei opens the blue pot. There is a dry layer of paint on top. Miss Wu removes it and mixes the paint herself. The children wait with clean brushes.

“We need a plan before we begin,” she says.

“The first group can use the paint first,” Leo says. Then it can pass the pot to the next group. A girl at the last table has a question. “The pot may be empty at our turn. What can we do then?”

Leo looks at the pot. “Use very little, then.”

“Who decides very little?” she asks.

Ronan thinks of the three stones. They were the same stones at every table. They can use the same stones again and again. But each group will use up some paint.

“We could put a little in each lid,” he says.

Miss Wu finds six clean lids. She divides some of the paint between the lids. She leaves a little in the pot for the cover.

Mei tries a thin blue line on a scrap. The white paper shows through. She likes that.

“The paper can be the bright water,” she says.

Ronan paints a line under their small boat. He still wants a large sea. He stops after the second line and looks at the lid. There is enough for Mei's side view too.

At the last table, the girl paints small dots. She leaves most of the paper white. “Can I use your idea?” Leo asks. He wants dots to show wind above his boat. She says yes, so he draws some there.

The book cover gets three short blue waves. The title goes above them in black pencil. They leave it open to dry in a clear space. No one's sleeve can brush across it there.

On the way home, Ronan catches his cuff on the gate. The old pale line shows again.

“Does it look bad?” he asks Mum.

“You are taller now.”

“Other children have new jackets.”

“Some do. This one still fits after I changed it. When this jacket is too short, we can think about another one.”

He turns his wrist. The sleeve reaches his hand. It keeps his wrist warm. He still likes the new jackets at school.

That evening he draws a small sea with two blue pencil lines. He uses the white of the page for the rest. Dad sees it beside the bowls.

“Clear water,” he says.

“Cheap water,” Ronan tells him.

Mum looks over. “The best kind to clean up.”

Ronan finds a safe place for his picture. The pencil lines are already dry. But he wants to keep the page clean.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- cuff＝袖口
- divides＝分给
- cover＝封面
- shows through＝透出来

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：sleeve＝衣袖；wrist＝手腕；layer＝薄层。

## 读句提示

**When this jacket is too short, we can think about another one.**

这件外套太短时／我们再考虑另一件。when只连一个完整条件，不叠加从句。

## 理解问题

1. 为什么老师先分装蓝色颜料？
2. Ronan对旧外套既有什么认识，又保留什么感受？
